It also tells students to cite AI and stay within instructor parameters. Included as the only fetchable statement of TSU's syllabus options; the Board AI policy PDF is no longer online. Tier 4 (university-general fallback).

documents.summary: Data structures syllabus with an AI-usage statement that defines AI broadly (any tool that edits writing or creates text, images or code) and allows it for brainstorming, exploring responses and creative work as each assignment permits. It stresses that coding assignments must follow the given starter code and specifications or earn little credit, and that exams reference assignments. Tier 1 (CS course).

documents.university: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center
documents.unit: TTUHSC Operating Policy (Chief Information Officer / AI Governance and Risk Committee)
documents.title: HSC OP: 52.21, Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Tools
documents.summary: Institution-wide operating policy on AI tools across education, research, clinical care and administration, built on transparency, accountability, fairness, privacy and human-supervision principles. For academics it bars completing academic work in ways the instructor has not allowed, AI-generated non-public instructional materials and grading, and entering FERPA-protected records into unapproved tools; it sets up an AI governance committee and biennial review. Tier 4 (university-general fallback).
